title: Chapter 258
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

One second to remember.

A web novel with no pop-up window!

The drifting dust was like a yellow fog, covering the sky with a layer of gauze. When the dust settled on the ground, the vision became clear.

In the wind, a figure struggled to get up and half-knelt on the ground.

Drip, drip …

Blood dripped from the corner of his mouth. The leader covered his face and slowly stood up.

At that moment, the air seemed to freeze, and the battlefield fell into a strange silence. Both friend and foe could not help but look over.

The leader of the Germinal Organization always wore a black metal mask. His identity was extremely mysterious, and almost no one had seen his true face.

To be able to lead such a huge force, he should be a famous figure. The intelligence agencies of various countries had many guesses about his identity. The Germinal Organization was established during the war of the Old Era, so the most likely guess was that the leader was an expert from the Old Era who changed his appearance.

Han Xiao could not help but look over. In his previous life, until the Germinal Organization disappeared in the river of history, the players did not discover the identity of the leader, so he did not know the true origin of the leader.

The leader put down his hand, and what appeared in front of everyone was an ugly face with crisscrossing scars, as if there were centipedes crawling under his skin. These scars were irregular in shape, as if they had been bitten and scratched by fierce beasts.

This was a completely unfamiliar face.

Although the appearance was terrible, the outline was still recognizable. Han Xiao was sure that he had not seen this face in the backlog of information. He looked at the strong people of the Six Nations and Bennett, and they were all confused.

No one knew the leader.

Bennett frowned. He was a Legend from the Old Era. He had an impression of all the powerful beings from the past, even those who had died in battle or of old age. However, he had no impression of the leader's face at all. There were only three possibilities for this.

First, the leader also wore a mask. Second, he had undergone plastic surgery to hide his identity. Third, he was not an active strong person of the Old Era and had been keeping a low profile.

His face was exposed, but the leader was expressionless, as if he did not care.

"No one knows him? Then is he wearing a mask because he is afraid that this face will affect the morale? " Han Xiao frowned. The leader's appearance was so ugly that it could make people cry. If he didn't wear a mask, he would probably have a [Morale -20] debuff aura.

The battle was not over yet, so Han Xiao tossed his doubts to the back of his mind. There were still thirty seconds before Viper's last breath. Without wasting any time, he dragged his war hammer and sprinted. Using the inertia, he swung the power war hammer horizontally.

Bang bang bang!!

The fist wrapped in black and purple flames clashed with the war hammer crazily, and the muffled sound of iron being struck rang out continuously.

The leader's eyes were sharp. He could tell that Han Xiao's mecha was on the verge of breaking down and would not be able to hold on for long. A mechanic without a mecha and equipment was like a tiger without teeth and claws.

Drag.

He switched to a defensive stance and allowed Han Xiao's warhammer to dance vigorously. Under the fierce beating of the storm, he was as tough as a reef.

His body, which had been tempered countless times, collided with the sturdy metal warhammer. The strong wind blew up dust and sand like waves!

Crackle!

Thirty seconds later, Viper let out an ominous sound. Pieces of components fell to the ground one after another like withered petals.

The entire mecha had broken down.

Han Xiao had revealed his true form.

"Hah!" The leader roared and instantly switched from a defensive stance to a frenzied attack. The strength that he had accumulated exploded, and he hit Han Xiao's abdomen with his full strength. He had already used his Armor Piercing skill, and the force behind it could penetrate through his organs.

Bang! Boom!

This attack caused two sounds. The palm hit Han Xiao's body, and the first sound was muffled. The second sound passed through Han Xiao's body and created a shockwave behind him. The sound was like the explosion of a cannonball, causing one's eardrums to buzz. The shockwave was ten times louder than the first sound. The sand behind Han Xiao was plowed into an inverted triangular shaped pit that went from deep to shallow.

The impact was huge, but Han Xiao's body only swayed a little. He did not even take half a step back. He actually managed to withstand the attack.

"How did you!" The leader was shocked and extremely surprised.

How could a mechanic withstand his fist with his body?
